description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). Table XH (no index at all) with rows (ID, N, G) inserted (5, 3, 1), (2, 7, 2), (8, 1, 1), (1, 6, 2), (7, 4, 1), (3, 8, 2), (6, 2, 1), (4, 5, 2) and s 'r1' to 'r8' in insertion order. Dynasets over the table name, SELECT ID, s FROM XH; SELECT ID, s FROM XH WHERE N >= 3; SELECT ID, s FROM XH WHERE G = 1; SELECT ID, s FROM XH WHERE s <> 'r4'; SELECT ID, s FROM XH WHERE ID > 2; then snapshots of the WHERE N >= 3 and WHERE s <> 'r4' statements as controls. Asks whether an unordered dynaset comes in storage order, primary-key order, or the order of an index on the WHERE column.
